body:
Hi Chris,

I was on your website this week, and one thing jumped out straight away. Halfway down the homepage there is a headline that reads 'We Guarentee the Highest Quality Landscaping,' and guarantee is spelled wrong. Your main headline has 'Commerical' misspelled too. The page is also one long wall of text, so your strongest selling points, 20 plus years in business, licensed and insured, 3x Best of Houzz winner, are buried in paragraphs, and your phone number only appears at the very bottom where most visitors never reach it.

So I redesigned your homepage, and the finished design is attached to this email as a PDF. It puts 239-205-8044 at the top of every screen, leads with landscaping and 24/7 tree removal, and gives your services and service areas their own clean sections.

Two similar sites from my portfolio: I built the website for Texas Landscape (texaslandscape.com), a landscaping company, with clear service pages and easy estimate requests. I also built Landscaping BCS (landscapingbcs.com), another landscaping company site, set up so customers can see what they do and where they work at a glance.

If you like the design, I can put it on your real domain and build out the rest of the pages. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings.

Best,
Hassan
name: Tri-County Landscape Services Inc
subject: 🌿 Chris, your homepage spells it 'Guarentee'
